solarNetwork.tagline: A calm social network for expressing yourself and meeting people.
solarNetwork.about.title: About Solar Network
solarNetwork.about.desc: Solian (also known as Solar Network) is a social platform for expressing yourself and connecting with others. We don't aim to replace any mainstream platform — just to offer another calm, harmonious community.
solarNetwork.features.title: Features
solarNetwork.features.desc: From daily socializing to interest-based communities, a complete social experience.
solarNetwork.features.timeline.title: Timeline
solarNetwork.features.timeline.desc: Browse by time, popularity, or recommendations. Follow people and get their updates in real time.
solarNetwork.features.reactions.title: Reactions
solarNetwork.features.reactions.desc: More than likes. React with love, laughter, surprise, or contemplation, on posts and comments alike.
solarNetwork.features.posts.title: Posts, Articles & Moments
solarNetwork.features.posts.desc: Short posts, long articles, and stories that disappear. Markdown, images, videos, and embeds all work.
solarNetwork.features.chat.title: Instant Messaging
solarNetwork.features.chat.desc: Real-time chat, one-on-one or in groups.
solarNetwork.features.realms.title: Realms
solarNetwork.features.realms.desc: Communities organized around shared interests. Find your people.
solarNetwork.features.oauth.title: OAuth Integration
solarNetwork.features.oauth.desc: Secure third-party sign-in. Multiple providers, no extra passwords to remember.
solarNetwork.features.checkin.title: Check-in
solarNetwork.features.checkin.desc: Share your location and daily status. Check in to build a timeline of where you've been, and find people and places nearby.
solarNetwork.features.countdown.title: Countdown
solarNetwork.features.countdown.desc: Countdowns for birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays. Share them with friends, set reminders, and celebrate on time.
solarNetwork.features.polls.title: Polls
solarNetwork.features.polls.desc: Polls for single-choice, multiple-choice, or ranked voting. Set deadlines, attach images, and watch results come in.
solarNetwork.features.rss.title: RSS Reader
solarNetwork.features.rss.desc: Follow blogs, news sites, and creators over RSS. Organize feeds into folders, mark articles read, and keep up in one reader.
solarNetwork.features.wallet.title: Wallet
solarNetwork.features.wallet.desc: Earn points for posting, reacting, and joining in. Spend them on premium features, virtual gifts, or tips for creators.
solarNetwork.features.stickers.title: Stickers
solarNetwork.features.editor.title: Rich Text Editor
solarNetwork.features.editor.desc: A Markdown editor with extended syntax.
solarNetwork.features.files.title: File Management
solarNetwork.features.files.desc: Upload and manage files — images, documents, audio, and video.
solarNetwork.features.social.title: Social Features
solarNetwork.features.social.desc: Friends lists, follow requests, and blocklists. Choose who sees your content, messages you, and interacts with your posts.
solarNetwork.features.collections.title: Post Collections
solarNetwork.features.collections.desc: Save posts into themed collections and reading lists, and share your picks with followers.
solarNetwork.features.fediverse.title: Fediverse
solarNetwork.features.fediverse.desc: Connect to the decentralized web over ActivityPub. Talk to users on Mastodon, Pixelfed, Misskey, and other federated platforms, and keep control of your data.
solarNetwork.features.achievements.title: Achievements & Progress
solarNetwork.features.achievements.desc: Badges for your first post, streaks, and community contributions. Check your progress and compare with friends.
solarNetwork.features.gallery.title: Photo Gallery
solarNetwork.features.subscription.title: Subscriptions
solarNetwork.features.subscription.desc: Follow creators and get notified when they post.
solarNetwork.features.more.title: And More
solarNetwork.features.more.desc: New features ship often, driven by community feedback. Join the beta to try them first.
solarNetwork.features.dashboard.title: Dashboard
solarNetwork.features.dashboard.desc: A personal overview: track activity and manage settings.
solarNetwork.features.events.title: Events
solarNetwork.features.events.desc: Mark important dates and share them with friends on Solar Network.
solarNetwork.features.eventCalendar.desc: See upcoming events in a calendar view.
solarNetwork.features.presences.title: Profile Presences
solarNetwork.features.presences.desc: Share what you're up to right now.
solarNetwork.features.developerHub.title: Developer Hub
solarNetwork.features.developerHub.desc: API docs, SDKs, OAuth app registration, integration management, and usage analytics.

cloudySky.tagline: Solar Network push notifications for regions without Firebase Cloud Messaging.

about.title: Push Notifications Without Firebase
about.desc: In many regions, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) is unavailable — leaving Solar Network users without real-time push notifications. CloudySky bridges that gap. It maintains a persistent connection to Solar Network's notification service via SSE streaming or intelligent polling, delivering real-time push notifications on Android without relying on Google Play Services.

notifications.title: No Firebase Required
notifications.desc: CloudySky works independently of Firebase Cloud Messaging, providing real-time push notifications even in regions where FCM is unavailable or unreliable.

secure.title: Secure Authentication
secure.desc: Sign in securely with OAuth 2.0 and PKCE. Your tokens are encrypted and stored safely using Android's Security-Crypto library.

realtime.title: Smart Connection
realtime.desc: Choose between Stream (SSE), Polling, or Dynamic mode. CloudySky adapts to your network and battery state for optimal performance.

features.title: Stay Connected, Effortlessly
features.desc: Everything you need to stay on top of your Solar Network activity.

oidc.title: OIDC Sign-in
oidc.desc: Secure authentication using AppAuth with PKCE flow — no client secret needed, fully OAuth 2.0 compliant.

sse.title: SSE Listener
sse.desc: Real-time Server-Sent Events deliver notifications instantly. Supports fallback to polling when SSE is unavailable.

grouping.title: Smart Grouping
grouping.desc: Notifications are grouped by room, author, topic, or type — making it easy to scan and manage your feed.

media.title: Rich Media Support
media.desc: View banner images, avatars, and multi-image collages directly in your notification shade.

reply.title: Quick Reply
reply.desc: Reply to conversations directly from notifications with inline reply actions.

settings.title: Flexible Settings
settings.desc: Connection mode, polling interval, stream timeout, silent mode — customize everything to your preferences.

android.title: Android 9.0+ (API 28)
android.desc: Requires Android Pie or later with Google Play Services recommended but not required.

account.title: Solarpass Account
account.desc: A Solar Network (Solarpass) account is required to sign in and receive notifications.

battery.title: Battery Optimization
battery.desc: For best results, exempt CloudySky from battery optimization to ensure reliable push delivery.

help.title: Need Help?
help.desc: Found a bug or need assistance? Report an issue on GitHub and we'll make it right.

about.title: Welcome to GoatCraft
about.desc: GoatCraft is Solsynth's community Minecraft server — a friendly survival world for builders, explorers, and casual players. Join from Java or Bedrock and play together in one shared world. Microsoft Minecraft accounts connect directly; Solarpass accounts can log in too.

community.title: Friendly Community
community.desc: A smaller, welcoming server where people know each other. No pay-to-win shops — just players, builds, and good company.

survival.title: Classic Survival
survival.desc: Vanilla-leaning survival with carefully chosen quality-of-life plugins. Keep the Minecraft feel while making multiplayer smoother.

auth.title: Microsoft or Solarpass
auth.desc: Have a Microsoft Minecraft account? Join directly. Prefer Solarpass? Sign in on AuthMC, then use a launcher with external login (auth server authmc).

features.title: What Awaits You
features.desc: Everything you need for a solid multiplayer survival experience — on Java or Bedrock.

auth.title: Solarpass Login
auth.desc: Sign in on AuthMC with Solarpass, then use a launcher with external login (auth server authmc) to join GoatCraft.

microsoft.title: Microsoft Accounts Welcome
microsoft.desc: Already own Minecraft with a Microsoft account? Connect to the server address and play — no extra setup required.

survival.title: Survival World
survival.desc: Explore a shared survival map — gather resources, build bases, and leave your mark on the world.

claims.title: Towns & Nations
claims.desc: Build your own town or nation, invite allies to settle, define your territory, and trade, cooperate, or compete with others.

economy.title: Player Economy
economy.desc: Trade with other players through shops and a light server economy — no cash shops, no pay-to-win.

events.title: Community Events
events.desc: Seasonal builds, mini-games, and community gatherings to keep the world feeling alive.

chat.title: Cross-Platform Chat
chat.desc: Java and Bedrock players share the same world and chat — stay in touch across editions.

backups.title: Regular Backups
backups.desc: World data is backed up regularly so progress is safe against the unexpected.

auth.title: Pick how you join
auth.desc: Three ways to get online. Solarpass is Java only — Bedrock players use Microsoft / Xbox.

microsoft.title: Microsoft account · Java Edition
microsoft.desc: If you already own Minecraft: Java Edition with a Microsoft account, connect and play — no extra website, no extra setup.

steps.1: Launch Minecraft: Java Edition and sign in with Microsoft.

solarpass.title: Solarpass · Java Edition only
solarpass.desc: Sign in on AuthMC with Solarpass, configure a launcher that supports external login (外置登录), then join the game server.
solarpass.hint: For external login, set the auth server to authmc (authmc.solsynth.dev). The game server is still playmc.solsynth.dev. Not available on Bedrock.

steps.1: Open authmc.solsynth.dev and sign in with Solarpass.
steps.2: In a Minecraft launcher with external login (外置登录), sign in using auth server authmc.
steps.3: Add game server playmc.solsynth.dev, join, and play.

bedrock.title: Bedrock Edition
bedrock.desc: Bedrock (Windows, mobile, console) joins with your Microsoft / Xbox account. Solarpass login is not supported on Bedrock.
bedrock.note: Solarpass cannot be used on Bedrock. Use a Microsoft / Xbox account linked to Minecraft Bedrock.

steps.1: Launch Minecraft: Bedrock Edition and sign in with Microsoft / Xbox.
steps.2: Servers → Add Server → address playmc.solsynth.dev (default Bedrock port if asked).
steps.3: Join and play — no AuthMC step.

howToJoin.title: Join & Sign In
howToJoin.desc: Finish login setup for your path on the right, then join the matching server. Java and Bedrock use different flows.

step1.title: Sign in
step1.desc: Microsoft accounts use the official launcher. Solarpass users sign in on AuthMC first.

step2.title: Configure your launcher
step2.desc: Solarpass needs a launcher with external login (外置登录) and auth server authmc. Microsoft / Bedrock use the official account flow.

step3.title: Join the server
step3.desc: Java game server is playmc.solsynth.dev; Bedrock is on its tab. Join and play.

solar.title: Connected with Solar Network
solar.desc: GoatCraft is more than a standalone server. It stays linked with the Solar Network community so chat, identity, and updates flow naturally in and out of the game.

chat.title: Synced chat
chat.desc: In-game chat mirrors Solar Network channels, so conversations continue whether you're in Minecraft or the community.

community.title: Community updates
community.desc: Server events, announcements, and player stories can be shared to the community so more people can join in.

account.title: Linked accounts
account.desc: Sign in with Solarpass to connect your community identity—less setup, more time to explore.

help.title: Need Help?
help.desc: Having trouble joining or found a problem on the server? Reach out to the Solsynth team and we'll sort it out.

maidKit.tagline: A cross-platform SSH server manager — non-intrusive maintenance for the servers you look after.

about.title: Server care without footprint
about.desc: MaidKit is the toolkit LittleSheep uses when acting as a “maid” for servers. Everything runs over SSH — no agents to install, no extra attack surface on the host. Built with Flutter for desktop and mobile, with the same calm, functional approach as the Island desktop apps.

ssh.title: SSH only
ssh.desc: Connect with credentials you already trust. No sidecars, no host agents, no elevated install on the server.

crossPlatform.title: Anywhere you work
crossPlatform.desc: Flutter builds for desktop and mobile so you can check load, open a terminal, or push a snippet from wherever you are.

vault.title: Encrypted vault
vault.desc: AES-GCM 256-bit credential storage with PBKDF2 key derivation, biometric unlock, and encrypted backup archives.

features.title: Everything a careful operator needs
features.desc: From live metrics and a full terminal to containers, projects, and reusable scripts — one calm workspace.

dashboard.title: Server dashboard
dashboard.desc: Grid of server cards with live status, load, memory, and uptime so you see health at a glance.

activity.title: Activity charts
activity.desc: Real-time CPU, memory, network, and disk charts for the servers you are watching.

terminal.title: Full SSH terminal
terminal.desc: Split panes, drag-and-drop tabs, and a command palette — powered by Ghostty or xterm renderers.

files.title: SFTP file browser
files.desc: Dual-pane browser with drag-and-drop transfers and an in-app editor for quick fixes.

services.title: Services
services.desc: Manage systemd units — start, stop, enable, disable.

processes.title: Processes
processes.desc: List and kill running processes; pin the ones you watch and track their usage over time.

webServers.title: Web servers
webServers.desc: nginx and Caddy configuration management without leaving the app.

ops.title: Crontab, packages, firewall
ops.desc: Edit scheduled tasks, manage packages (apt, dnf, and more), and control UFW, firewalld, nftables, or iptables.

tunnels.title: Tunnels, proxy & jump hosts
tunnels.desc: Local and remote port forwarding with saved presets, HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5 proxy, and hopping through another managed server.

containers.title: Containers
containers.desc: Docker and Podman lifecycle control, Compose project grouping, image management, and runtime install help.

projects.title: Deployment projects
projects.desc: Group compose stacks, web servers, and containers; import and export as TOML.

snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.desc: Reusable shell scripts run on one or many servers, with streaming output and progress.

security.title: Credential security
security.desc: AES-GCM vault, 310,000-iteration PBKDF2, biometric unlock, and encrypted .mkb backups.

databases.title: Databases
databases.desc: PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB: engine inspection, logical backups and restores, quick maintenance, and pgBackRest.

tailscale.title: Tailscale
tailscale.desc: Connect over your tailnet with an embedded node — no Tailscale app required.

maidcafe.title: MaidCafe Cloud
maidcafe.desc: Optional fleet layer: an outbound-only daemon streams live metrics, evaluates alarm thresholds locally, and exposes an audit log and CI/CD API credentials.

agent.title: AI agent
agent.desc: Chat with an agent that operates your servers through tools. Bring your own AI provider; proposed actions need your approval before they run.

github.title: GitHub
github.desc: Sign in with device flow, pin repositories, and follow workflow runs, pull requests, and releases.

mcp.title: Local MCP server
mcp.desc: Expose MaidKit's SSH servers, snippets, and skills to other agents on this machine via Model Context Protocol.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Theme and accent color, terminal renderer and scheme, connect on startup, and hide server addresses when sharing your screen.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.desc: Built with Flutter — the same codebase on the machines you already use.

help.title: Need Help?
help.desc: Found a bug or have feedback? Open an issue on GitHub and we'll take a look.

persynth.tagline: A quiet island-style desktop pet companion — an ASCII face with a mood of its own, and a Personality Core you can talk to.

about.title: A companion that lives on your desktop
about.desc: Persynth is a desktop-first companion that lives in a floating, always-on-top island window. Its face is drawn in ASCII, it keeps its own energy and affection, and it reacts to being fed, played with or put to rest — all simulated on your machine, so the pet is alive even when nothing is talking to it. Sign in with your Solar Network account and the same character opens a conversation surface with a Personality Core agent: streamed replies, reasoning traces and tool traces, typed chat on every platform, and voice input on Android, iOS and the web.

island.title: Island window
island.desc: A frameless 340x420 window that skips the taskbar and stays on top, living beside a larger conversation console.

localLife.title: A life simulated locally
localLife.desc: Energy, affection and eight moods decay and recover on your own machine, so the pet keeps living with the network unplugged.

core.title: Personality Core
core.desc: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint on your Solar Network account gives the character a memory and a bond score — no separate API key.

features.title: A pet, a console and a plugin host
features.desc: Every capability is a plugin with its own switch: what is off is never offered to the model.

face.title: A face made of text
face.desc: Face parts such as 0.0, 0-0 and 0^0, configurable and persisted locally on your machine.

moods.title: Moods and stats
moods.desc: Neutral, happy, sad, sleepy, curious, excited, lonely and focused — driven by energy and affection.

care.title: Feed, play, rest
care.desc: Interactions that move the numbers, with idle decay that keeps running while you are away.

chat.title: Personality Core chat
chat.desc: Streamed replies from an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, authenticated with your Solar Network token.

traces.title: Reasoning and tool traces
traces.desc: The console shows what the agent thought and which tools it called, folded away until you want them.

voice.title: Voice and keyboard
voice.desc: Typed chat on every platform, speech-to-text on Android, iOS and the web.

harness.title: A validated behaviour harness
harness.desc: The model may only change mood, face, status and animation through a checked JSON directive, so the pet stays coherent.

switches.title: One switch per plugin
switches.desc: A plugin owns its tools, its prompt text and the on/off switch — a capability boundary, not a preference.

sets.title: Nine Solar Network sets
sets.desc: Feed, messages, notifications, calendar, rituals, profile, wallet, mail and boards — off by default, loaded on demand.

sandbox.title: JavaScript script plugins
sandbox.desc: Drop in a folder with a manifest and a main script; it runs in its own QuickJS sandbox and is quarantined if it crashes.

webtools.title: Web tools from your own IP
webtools.desc: Built-in web search and fetch run on your machine, so answers arrive without bot-check walls.

bond.title: Bond dashboard
bond.desc: The affection score with its level and latest reason, plus a reset that clears that agent's memories and history.

help.title: Need help?
help.desc: Found a bug, or wrote a plugin worth sharing? Open an issue in the repository and we will take a look.

solWatt.tagline: The Solar Network workspace client — threaded mail, kanban boards and a team cloud drive in one desktop-first app.

about.title: Your whole workspace, in one window
about.desc: SolWatt is the Solar Network client from Solsynth. Sign in with your Solar Network account, pick a workspace, and that workspace's services come together in a single shell: conversation-threaded mail, kanban boards that sync with GitHub issues, a team cloud drive with live quota, notifications and a realtime feed. It is desktop-first — a native window frame with rail navigation on Windows, Linux and macOS — with iOS and Android builds, English and Simplified Chinese, light and dark themes, eight accent colors and switchable app icons.

shell.title: One shell, many services
shell.desc: Mail, boards, drive, notifications and the app-data browser share one navigation, one sign-in and one window.

workspace.title: Workspaces everywhere
workspace.desc: Every mail, board, drive and flywheel request is scoped to the workspace you chose at the gate.

realtime.title: Live by default
realtime.desc: A websocket gateway keeps notifications, task changes and board events flowing, with background push behind it.

features.title: The workspace client, at desktop scale
features.desc: Everything you use on the web, sized for a keyboard, a mouse and a real window.

signIn.title: Solar Network sign-in
signIn.desc: OAuth with PKCE on native desktops and the device-code flow on the web, then a gate to choose or create a workspace.

workspaces.title: Workspaces as the unit of everything
workspaces.desc: Membership, switching, leaving and a provisioned personal workspace — every request carries the one you picked.

mail.title: Threaded mail (ElecPostal)
mail.desc: One row per conversation with server-side counts, reply chaining, multi-select, star, move, trash and empty-trash.

mailImport.title: Import .eml and .mbox
mailImport.desc: Client-side parsing in batches of 500, with attachments uploaded to the workspace drive as a background task.

boards.title: Kanban boards (Ideask)
boards.desc: A lane per group with drag-and-drop cards, priorities, deadlines, tags, assignees, comments and cover images.

github.title: GitHub issue sync
github.desc: Install the GitHub App, link repositories and keep issues on the cards — mirrored comments included.

drive.title: Workspace drive (DysonFS)
drive.desc: Indexed folders and unindexed assets, live quota, drag-and-drop uploads, rename, move and per-file permissions.

viewer.title: A viewer that stays in the app
viewer.desc: Image lightbox with EXIF, video and audio playback, and document previews without leaving the workspace.

notifications.title: Ring inbox
notifications.desc: An island-style attention sheet over any screen, with an unread badge and mark-all-read.

realtime.title: Realtime feed
realtime.desc: A websocket gateway with heartbeat and reconnect backoff folds new notifications and task changes straight into the UI.

push.title: Background push
push.desc: Metoer subscriptions over FCM and APNs, so the workspace reaches you while the app is closed.

desktop.title: Desktop-first shell
desktop.desc: Native window frame, rail or drawer navigation, a background task overlay, light and dark themes, eight accents, English and Chinese.

flywheel.title: Flywheel app data
flywheel.desc: Browse the workspace's encrypted app data — owner apps, blobs, revisions and audit entries — from the same shell.

help.title: Need help?
help.desc: Found a bug or missing a service? Open an issue in the repository and we will take a look.
